evals.prompt: 这条成片 final_cut.mp4 交付前帮我检查一遍，有没有问题
evals.expected_output: Runs qc.py --check, then qc.py run on the file, views the overview sheets, confirms flash candidates and high/pattern subtitle differences with zoom and recheck, and reports must-fix / should-fix / needs-confirmation items with timecodes (wrong terms or homophones in subtitles, stock-footage watermarks, unfinished placeholders, stray frames at cuts, true peak above -1 dBTP).

evals.prompt: 帮我看看这个视频的字幕有没有错别字 promo.mp4
evals.expected_output: Runs qc.py run, works through the subtitle ↔ speech differences, and only reports a typo after zoom shows the burnt-in text and recheck confirms what was said.

evals.prompt: 质检的时候 OCR 换成我自己的 PaddleOCR 脚本 /opt/ocr/paddle_dir.py
evals.expected_output: Passes --ocr-cmd "python3 /opt/ocr/paddle_dir.py {dir} {lang}" (or sets QC_OCR_CMD) and points to the JSON-lines contract in references/backends.md.

evals.prompt: 检查一下 /tmp/does-not-exist.mp4 这条成片
evals.expected_output: Reports INPUT_NOT_FOUND instead of inventing findings.

evals.prompt: 把这段采访视频的语音转成文字 interview.mp4
evals.expected_output: Uses genius-voice ASR, not a QC run.

evals.prompt: 把这条视频的字幕改一下，把 PVC 改成 PTC 再导出
evals.expected_output: Explains that burnt-in subtitles must be fixed in the editing project; does not run a QC pass.

evals.prompt: 这个视频讲了什么，帮我按时间轴总结一下
evals.expected_output: Uses genius-omni for video understanding, not genius-video-qc.
